name: bolivia-remote-scout
description: Public self-contained Cloudflare Worker to filter, scan, and evaluate 100% remote job opportunities from Bolivia (Spanish Bolivia first + English)

scripts.build-html: node -e "import('./src/ui.js').then(async ({ renderAppHtml }) => { const { INITIAL_OPPORTUNITIES, INITIAL_PLATFORMS } = await import('./src/seed_data.js'); const fs = await import('node:fs'); fs.writeFileSync('index.html', renderAppHtml({ opportunities: INITIAL_OPPORTUNITIES, platforms: INITIAL_PLATFORMS, lastScanAt: new Date().toISOString() }), 'utf8'); console.log('Generated self-contained index.html'); })"
